platform.heading: Six modules. One engine. Every line.
platform.lead: Each capability a claim needs, built once and reused across insurance lines — motor today, health next. Buy one module, a bundled engine, or the whole stack.

modules.name: Capture
modules.desc: Collect documents and images from the customer across channels — a guided link, SMS, WhatsApp, email, or your own systems by API.

modules.name: Document Intelligence
modules.desc: Extract the useful information from any claim document — policies, estimates, invoices, RCs, FIRs.

modules.name: Verification
modules.desc: Prove documents are real and consistent — tampering checks and cross-source matching against Vahan and registries.

modules.name: Image Intelligence
modules.desc: Read the photos. Damaged parts and severity for motor; medical images and bills for health.

modules.name: Fraud
modules.desc: One risk score over the documents and images — with the reason behind every flag.

modules.name: Agentic Settlement
modules.desc: The agent that orchestrates the stack to run the claim end to end. Straight-through for the clean, investigator-ready for the rest.

platform.footnote: Build a capability once, reuse it down every line. “Agentic Settlement” is on the roadmap.

how.heading: One request in, one report out

steps.title: Send what you have
steps.desc: Email, SMS or WhatsApp a capture link to the customer. Or upload files from the dashboard, or send them by API.

steps.title: We check it
steps.desc: The engine finds damaged parts, reads the plate and chassis, checks them against Vahan, reads every document and runs fraud rules across it all.

steps.title: Your team decides
steps.desc: A PDF report and a JSON response land in your dashboard and your systems. Flagged files go to your investigators with reasons attached.

send.heading: Send photos, documents, or both
send.lead: The report adapts to what you send. You never pay for a section you did not need.

modes.name: Documents only
modes.returns: Score, flags and the extracted fields behind them.

modes.name: Photos or video only
modes.returns: Damage map, parts table, Vahan result and evidence.

modes.name: Both
modes.returns: The full report — damage and documents on one page, with the flags that explain the score.

capture.heading: Photos and paperwork, from the customer or the garage
capture.lead: The insurer sends a capture link to whoever has the evidence — the customer or the garage. They submit vehicle photos and a short video, plus the claim documents, from a phone. No app to install, and quality is checked on both.
points: Link sent by SMS, WhatsApp or email to the customer or the garage, valid for a limited time.
Step-by-step vehicle photos and a short walkaround video, each angle guided by an outline.
Snap or upload the documents too — RC, policy, estimate, invoice — in the same flow.
Instant checks on both: dark, blurry or partial shots and unreadable pages are caught before submit.
Consent is shown first and recorded with the case. Hindi and English.
Staff can skip the link and upload from the dashboard or API.

developers.heading: A REST API and webhooks
developers.lead: Create a case, attach files, and receive the result as JSON. You get a webhook when the report is ready. Every report also comes as a PDF.
points: Send any mix of images, video and documents — PDF, JPG or PNG.
The response only contains the sections that match what you sent.
Sandbox keys for testing before you go live.

endpoints.purpose: Create a case for a claim or inspection

audience.heading: Built for the people who handle the claim

roles.title: Faster first look
roles.desc: Small own-damage claims arrive with damaged parts and severity already listed, so the desk starts from a report instead of a pile of photos.

roles.title: Flags with reasons
roles.desc: Each flag shows what was compared and why it looks wrong, so investigators start from evidence.

roles.title: Break-in inspections
roles.desc: Inspect a lapsed or used-car policy from the customer’s phone, with the plate and chassis checked against Vahan.

principle.text: The engine never approves or rejects a claim. It tells your team where to look.
principle.sub: Every flag carries its reason, and the human decides. Explainable by design.

pricing.heading: Start self-serve. Grow to the whole claim.
pricing.lead: Same engine, two ways to buy. Transparent usage pricing on the self-serve tier — not demo-gated like the rest of the category.
